40008364.author: पदार्थः
40008364.content: अथ and then, रघुनन्दनः delight of the Raghus, रामः Rama, दुःखार्दितम् afflicted, आश्रमात् from the hermitage, उपावृत्तम् returned, सौमित्रिम् Lakshmana, अन्तरा in the midst, पुनः again, परिपप्रच्छ questioned.

40008364.author: Translation
40008364.content: Rama, the delight of the Raghus, once again questioned Lakshmana who had come out of the hermitage, deeply hurt:

40008365.author: पदार्थः
40008365.content: तम् him, उवाच had said, तव your, विश्वासात् with the confidence, मया myself, सा she, वने  in the forest, यदा as such, विरहिता left, मैथिलीम् Maithili, किमर्थम् for what reason, उपास्य having left her, त्वम् you, आगतः came.

40008365.author: Translation
40008365.content: Why did you come, leaving the princess from Mithila alone in the forest when I had left her under your trust ?

40008366.author: पदार्थः
40008366.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, मैथिलीम् Maithili, त्यज्य left, अभ्यागतम् your coming, त्वाम् your, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing, मनः in my mind, महत् great, पापम् evil, शङ्कमानम् doubted, व्यथितम् (इति) यत् I was pained, सत्यम् it was true.

40008366.author: Translation
40008366.content: When I saw you, O Lakshmana, coming without Sita, my mind was oppressed with evil thought which have come true.

40008367.author: पदार्थः
40008367.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, सीताविरहितम् without Sita, त्वाम् you, दूरे at a distance, पथि on the way, दृष्ट्वा seeing, मे mine, सव्यम् left, नयनम् eye, बाहुश्च shoulder, स्फुरते throbbing, मे my, हृदयं च heart too.

40008367.author: Translation
40008367.content: O Lakshmana, as I saw you from a distance without Sita, my left eye, my shoulder and my heart throbbed.

40008368.author: पदार्थः
40008368.content: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having been spoken, सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, शुभलक्षणः endowed with good  traits, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भूयः again, दुःखसमाविष्टः drowned in greater sorrow, दुःखितम् sorrowful, रामम् to Rama, अब्रवीत् said.

40008368.author: Translation
40008368.content: Thus addressed, virtuous Lakshmana, overwhelmed with sorrow replied to the grief stricken Rama:

40008369.author: पदार्थः
40008369.content: अहम् I, ताम् her, स्वयम् on my own, त्यक्त्वा after leaving, कामकारेण by my own desire, इह here, न आगतः not come, तयैव by herself, उग्रैः with angry words, प्रचोदितः provoked, इह here, त्वत्सकाशम् to you, आगतः I came.

40008369.author: Translation
40008369.content: I did not leave her on my own nor have I  come here of my own accord. I came to you, provoked by her angry  words.

40008370.author: पदार्थः
40008370.content: हा सीते Alas, Sita, हा लक्ष्मण Alas, Lakshmana, इति च these words, परित्राहि इति save  me, यत् such, आर्येणेव as if your noble self, पराक्रुष्टम् loudly, तत् then, मैथिल्याः Maithili's, श्रुतिम् to her ears, गतम् reached.

40008370.author: Translation
40008370.content: Uttered loudly, 'Alas Sita, Alas, Lakshmana, save me', as if these were the words of your noble self, reached Sita's ears.

40008371.author: पदार्थः
40008371.content: सा मैथिली that Maithili, तम् that, आर्तस्वरम् cry of pain, श्रुत्वा hearing, रुदन्ती crying, तव स्नेहेन  because of her love for you, भयविह्वला wild with fear, गच्छ गच्छ इति go, go, माम् to me said, आह pleaded.

40008371.author: Translation
40008371.content: The princess from Mithila heard this cry of pain and, wild with fear, urged me out of her love for you to go.

40008372.author: पदार्थः
40008372.content: गच्छ इति saying go, तया Sita, बहुशः many ways, प्रचोद्यमानेन while being provoked, मया by me, मैथिली Maithili, त्वत्प्रत्ययान्वितम्  cofidence in her, इदम् these, वाक्यम् words, प्रत्युक्ता replied.

40008372.author: Translation
40008372.content: When I was repeated asked to go, I said this in order to instil confidence in the princess from Mithila :

40008373.author: पदार्थः
40008373.content: अस्य his, यत् Rama, भयम् fear, आवहेत् who can cause, तत् such, रक्षः demon, अहम् I, न पश्यामि I do not see, निर्वृता give up fear, भव your, एतत् this, नास्ति does not exist, केनापि by some one, एवम् in that way, उदाहृतम् is uttered.

40008373.author: Translation
40008373.content: 'No one  can cause fear in Rama. I do not see any demon who can hold a threat to him. Give up fear. Some one might have said it.

40008374.author: पदार्थः
40008374.content: सीते O Sita, यः he, त्रिदशानपि even gods, त्रायेत् he may save, आर्यः capable one, विगर्हितम् demeaning, नीचं च lowly, त्राहि इति saying 'save me', वचनम् words, कथम् how, अभिधास्यति will speak out?

40008374.author: Translation
40008374.content: 'How can Rama who is capable of saving even gods speak such unworthy, demeaning words, 'Save me, O Sita'

40008375.author: पदार्थः
40008375.content: शोभने O fair lady, किं निमित्तं तु for some reason, केनापि राक्षसेन by some demon, मे भ्रातुः my brother's, स्वरम् voice, आलम्ब्य adapting, त्राहि त्राहि इति 'save me, save me', वाक्यम् these words, ईरितम् is said.

40008375.author: Translation
40008375.content: O fair lady, for some reason some demon  has uttered these words 'Save me, save me' adapting my brother's voice.

40008376.author: पदार्थः
40008376.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, माम् me, त्राहि save me, इति thus, विस्वरम् in an altered voice, वाक्यम्  these words, व्याहृतम् uttered, भवत्या yourself, कुनारीजनसेविता like an ordinary lowborn woman, व्यथा pain, न कार्या not to be taken.

40008376.author: Translation
40008376.content: 'Lakshmana, save me' are the words uttered in an altered tone. Like an ordinary, lowborn woman you are not to feel concerned for this.

40008377.author: पदार्थः
40008377.content: वैक्लब्यम् bewilderment, आलम्ब्य resorting to, अलम् no need, निरुत्सुका frustrated, स्वस्था भव you should be calm, यः whoever, संयुगेरणे in an encounter, राघवम् Rama, पराजयेत् defeat, सः he, पुमान् a man, त्रिषु लोकेषु in the three worlds, जातो वा is born in the past, जायमानो वा or going to be born, नास्ति is not there, राघवः Rama, शक्रपुरोगमैः by those led by Indra, देवैः by gods, युद्धे in war, न जय्यः cannot be conquered.

40008377.author: Translation
40008377.content: 'You should not feel agitated or dispirited. Be composed. There is no one either born or going to be born in the three worlds who can defeat Rama in war. He cannot be conquered in a battle even by gods led by indra.'

40008378.author: पदार्थः
40008378.content: वैक्लब्यम् bewilderment, आलम्ब्य resorting to, अलम् no need, निरुत्सुका frustrated, स्वस्था भव you should be calm, यः whoever, संयुगेरणे in an encounter, राघवम् Rama, पराजयेत् defeat, सः he, पुमान् a man, त्रिषु लोकेषु in the three worlds, जातो वा is born in the past, जायमानो वा or going to be born, नास्ति is not there, राघवः Rama, शक्रपुरोगमैः by those led by Indra, देवैः by gods, युद्धे in war, न जय्यः cannot be conquered.

40008378.author: Translation
40008378.content: 'You should not feel agitated or dispirited. Be composed. There is no one either born or going to be born in the three worlds who can defeat Rama in war. He cannot be conquered in a battle even by gods led by indra.'

40008379.author: पदार्थः
40008379.content: एवम् in that way, उक्ता  consoled, वैदेही Vaidehi, परिमोहितचेतना of deluded intellect, अश्रूणि tears, मुञ्चन्ती shedding, माम् me, दारुणं harsh, इदं वचः these words, उवाच said.

40008379.author: Translation
40008379.content: Deluded by her senses, Vaidehi said these words, shedding tears when I  tried to console  her:

40008380.author: पदार्थः
40008380.content: भ्रातरि brother, विनष्टे is deceased, प्राप्तुम् to get, मयि me, अत्यर्थम् extremely, पापः भाव एव sinful thought only, तव you, निवेशितः is set, त्वम् you, माम् me, न च अवाप्स्यसि will not be able to gain.

40008380.author: Translation
40008380.content: 'You have an extremely sinful intention of getting me  when your brother is dead. But you will not be able to gain me.

40008381.author: पदार्थः
40008381.content: अत्यर्थम् intensely, क्रोशन्तम्  shouting for help, यथा as, एवम् in this, नाभ्यवपद्यसे  are not going, त्वम् you, भरतेन by Bharata, सङ्केतात् instruction, रामम् Rama,समनुगच्छसि followed.

40008381.author: Translation
40008381.content: 'Since you are not reaching out to Rama who is helplessly crying for his rescue, you must have followed Rama, instructed by Bharata (to do him harm)'৷৷

40008382.author: पदार्थः
40008382.content: प्रच्छन्नचारी in disguise, रिपुः enemy, त्वम् you, राघवस्य Rama's, अन्तरप्रेप्सुः waiting for an opportunity, मदर्थम् for my sake, अनुगच्छसि are following, तथा like this, एनम् him, नाभिपद्यसे not going now.

40008382.author: Translation
40008382.content: 'You are an enemy moving in disguise with an interest in me. You are waiting for an opportunity to set aside Rama. That is why you are not rushing to him.'

40008383.author: पदार्थः
40008383.content: वैदेह्या by Vaidehi, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, संरब्धः an agitated person, क्रोधात् in anger, रक्तलोचनः with reddened eye, स्फुरमाणोष्ठः quivering lips, आश्रमात् from the hermitage, अभिनिर्गतः came out.

40008383.author: Translation
40008383.content: At these words from the princess of Videha, I came out of the hermitage in an agitated mood with my eyes turned red and lips quivering in anger.

40008384.author: पदार्थः
40008384.content: एवम् in that way, ब्रुवाणम् as he was telling, सौमित्रिम् Lakshmana, सन्तापमोहितः overtaken by grief, रामः Rama, अब्रवीत् said, सौम्य noble, यत् since, त्वम् you, तां विना without her, आगतः came, दुष्कृतम् a wrong act, कृतम् is done.

40008384.author: Translation
40008384.content: To Lakshmana thus reporting, Rama, overcome with grief, said,(Even then) O noble brother your coming here, leaving her behind, is a wrong step taken.

40008385.author: पदार्थः
40008385.content: माम् me, रक्षसाम् of demons, विनिवारणे in warding off, समर्थम् capable, जानन्नपि even knowing , भवान् yourself, मैथिल्याः Maithili's, अनेन by this, क्रोधवाक्येन angry words, निस्सृतः came out.

40008385.author: Translation
40008385.content: You have come out of the hermitage provoked by Maithili's angry words, even though you are aware that I am capable of warding off the demons.

40008386.author: पदार्थः
40008386.content: मैथिलीम् Maithili, त्यक्त्वा left, यद्यासि that you came, ते with you, न परितुष्यामि not pleased, त्वम् you, क्रुद्धायाः angry, परुषम् harsh, श्रुत्वा  listening, ताम् her, विहाय  deserting, इह here, आगतः came.

40008386.author: Translation
40008386.content: I am not happy with you as you have come here deserting Sita on the plea that she was angry and spoke harsh words.

40008387.author: पदार्थः
40008387.content: सीतया by Sita, प्रचोदितः you are urged, क्रोधस्य by anger's, वशम् grip, आपन्नः came, मम my, शासनम् orders, नाकरोः (इति) यत् not respected, सर्वथा by all means, ते your, अविनीतम् act of disobedience.

40008387.author: Translation
40008387.content: Provoked by the words of Sita spoken in anger you came without respecting my orders. It is definitely an act of disobedience.

40008388.author: पदार्थः
40008388.content: मृगरूपेण in the guise of a deer, येन by whom, अहम् I, आश्रमात् from the hermitage, अपवाहितः was taken away, असौ राक्षसः this demon, मया by me, शरेण with an arrow, अभिहतः he is killed, शेते lies.

40008388.author: Translation
40008388.content: This demon who misled me in the guise of a deer and took me away from the hermitage, lies dead, killed by my arrow.

40008389.author: पदार्थः
40008389.content: मया by me, चापम् bow, विकृष्य bending, सायकम् an arrow, परिधाय after fixing, सलीलबाणेन arrow released with ease, ताडितः beaten , सः he, मार्गीम्  a deer, तनुम् body, त्यज्य having, सविक्लबस्वर: painful voice, केयूरधरः with a bracelet, राक्षसः demon, बभूव lay down.

40008389.author: Translation
40008389.content: Bending the bow I fixed the arrow and released it at ease. Hit by that arrow he gave up his guise of the deer and assuming the form of a demon with a bracelet on his arm fell down groaning.

40008390.author: पदार्थः
40008390.content: तदा then, शराहतेनैव as soon as he was hit by the arrow, आर्तया in distress, गिरा with a voice, सुदूरसुश्रवम्  even heard from a distance, स्वरम् voice, समालम्ब्य adapting, सुदारुणम् very dreadful, तत् that, वचनम् words, उदाहृतम्  uttered, येन by which, त्वम् you, मैथिलीम् Maithili, विहाय after deserting, इह here, आगतः came.

40008390.author: Translation
40008390.content: Hit by the arrow, the demon imitating my voice cried out in desperation which could be clearly audible even from a distance. On hearing the dreadful words you deserted Sita and came here. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyninth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
